Would you like an internship where your analyses help drive real business decisions? Are you excited by the opportunity to work with data, AI and modern analytics tools in an international green-tech company? Does gaining hands-on experience with Power BI, ServiceNow and Claude AI sound like the perfect foundation for your future career?

Here is what your role entails

As our new Data Analyst Intern, your responsibility will be to help Customer Services transform data into insights that support business decisions and continuous improvements.

More specifically, you will be:

• Analyzing Customer Services performance

• Identifying improvement opportunities

• Tracking costs and income streams

• Developing dashboards and tracking KPIs

• Exploring data-driven and AI opportunities

This internship offers the opportunity to work with real business challenges, where your insights create impact. You will gain hands-on experience with technologies and platforms such as Power BI, ServiceNow and Claude AI while helping shape a newly established area with plenty of room for learning and development. Furthermore, you will have the opportunity to influence your focus areas throughout the internship based on your interests and development goals.

Meet your future team

With direct reference to Head of Service Development - Heat/Cooling Customer Services, you will become part of a newly established team in Customer Services focused on service development, business processes, and data analysis. Together our mission is to enable Customer Services to continuously improve how we deliver, support, and develop services. Collaboration is at the heart of how we work, and you can expect close interaction with colleagues from Customer Services as well as Product Management, Sales, Software Development and Digitalization. As a team, we value knowledge sharing, professional sparring, and a strong desire to continuously improve the way we work.

Did you know? In our team, we have many different talents – we have both a former professional drummer, a race car driver and one of the best board game players in Denmark, just to name a few.

Less about us, more about you

We are looking for a curious and analytical student who enjoys working with data and turning insights into action. You are motivated by solving real business challenges and eager to explore how data and AI can create value in practice.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Hold a degree in Data Science, Business Intelligence, Business Analytics, Economics, or a related field

• Have strong analytical skills and is comfortable working with quantitative data

• Have an interest in working with AI and tools such as Power BI or similar visualization tools

As we are an international organization, it is important that you are fluent in English. Danish is considered an advantage, but not a requirement.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, this is an internship position, and we value curiosity and a willingness to learn just as much as experience. If the role interests you and you are motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply.

We offer more than just an internship

At Kamstrup, your contribution as an intern is highly valued, and we cherish the good colleagueship. Therefore, you will experience an internship with a strong focus on your individual development through challenging tasks, career sparring, voluntary courses, as well as social events and a large network. We are proud, that our internship program has resulted in Studenterhus Aarhus granting us with the Mentor Award, the Internationalization Award, the Jury’s Special Award and the award for East Jutland’s Best Internship.

Besides the best program, we also offer:

• A gratuity which may be provided in recognition of your efforts if your place of study allows it as well as paid public transportation to and from work

• Multiple internship events and weekly internship lunches

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in-house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association, that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

Do you want to be a part of Kamstrup?

The applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, but you can expect a response within six weeks. Any details about the internship will be individually agreed upon. However, the internship is expected to run from the beginning of February 2027 until the end of June 2027.

The Role

We’re looking for a developer with a user-centric mindset and a drive to evolve the product in step with the market, execute our roadmap, and meet client expectations. You’ll work with modern technologies and have a significant opportunity to grow, diversify your skill set, and contribute to an exciting growth journey.

You’ll also contribute to broader business topics at BELLA, including the product roadmap, IT infrastructure, and domain-specific decisions. About BELLA Intelligence

BELLA Intelligence, part of Karnov Group, is a cloud-based SaaS platform that streamlines daily workflows for managing insolvency cases. Our service includes secure hosting of case-related data.

We’re a small, flat, and highly transparent team with a strong professional culture. About Karnov

Karnov Group is a leading provider of critical legal, tax, and compliance information across Denmark, Sweden, Norway, France, Spain, and Portugal. We’re in the midst of an exciting transformation — evolving from a traditional publisher into a modern technology company.

Throughout the entire Karnov Group we work on a foundation of trust and transparency, and psychological safety is a key value in our culture. You’ll work alongside talented colleagues who support each other and share a drive to build the best tools possible for our customers. We’re located right by Nørreport Station in central Copenhagen. We offer great flexibility and expect you to take ownership and responsibility together with your team. We have a common-sense driven hybrid remote policy.

Apply

Interested? Reach out to Kenan Jugo, Commercial Director, Portfolio Companies, at kenan.jugo@karnovgroup.com . We’re reviewing applications on a rolling basis and will hire as soon as we find the right candidate. We look forward to hearing from you.

Directure is an international management consulting firm devoted to advising and assisting organisations within life science, healthcare and other regulated industries, to realise their strategy aspirations. We operate through an integrated approach to consulting, combining best practice standards and disciplines of Management Consulting, International Search and People Resource Consulting. Today, Directure advises a variety of companies that seek guidance and counselling on business and senior leadership needs with an increasing access to executives around the world. We combine the in-depth expertise of an international advisor with the focus and flexibility of a boutique consulting firm that has put impact above size.

Coordinator / Associate

The Role

Part Coordinator, part Associate — all inside the work

Directure's consultants run complex, multi-client advisory practices. They need someone close — someone who keeps the operational side running with precision while also contributing to the substantive work: research, analysis, and the polished outputs clients receive.

This Associate/Coordinator role sits at the intersection of those two things. You will own the administrative infrastructure that makes consultants effective — diary, travel, planning, correspondence — and you will contribute directly to client deliverables: desk research, data synthesis, and advanced PowerPoint presentations built to a consulting standard.

It is an unusual position, and deliberately so. You will see the full arc of consulting engagements, from brief to delivery, without the distance that typical coordinator roles create. For the right person — organised, analytical, and ambitious — it is an accelerated route into consulting work.

Responsibilities

Two distinct, equally important areas of work

Administration & Coordination

• Own and manage a complex partner and consultant diaries — scheduling, sequencing, and protecting time for deep work

• Plan and coordinate all travel: flights, accommodation, ground logistics, and changes in the field

• Prepare meeting agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up actions; manage correspondence independently where appropriate

• Track project timelines, upcoming milestones, and internal team deadlines across active engagements

• Administrative coordination with Finance.

• Maintain organised filing systems and document libraries for ongoing project matters

Research, Analysis & Presentations

• Conduct desk research on industries, markets, competitors, and regulatory environments in support of client engagements

• Synthesise findings into structured summaries and analytical frameworks ready for review

• Build and maintain advanced PowerPoint presentations — slide logic, visual hierarchy, data visualisation — to a standard appropriate for senior client audiences

• Support data gathering and basic modelling tasks using Excel

• Assist in preparing pitch materials, proposals, and thought-leadership content

• Quality-check outputs before client delivery: language, consistency, and visual finish

What We're Looking For

Skills, background, and ways of working

• An academic degree and experience in a professional services, consulting, corporate, or equivalent environment — you understand what high-standard output looks like

• Strong PowerPoint skills are essential: you can build a structured, visually coherent presentation from a brief, not just populate a template

• Research-literate — comfortable gathering, assessing, and structuring information from multiple sources into something useful for decision-making

• Organised in a way that holds under pressure: priorities shift, deadlines accelerate, and you adapt without dropping things

• Excellent written communication in English; your drafts need minimal editing before they go out

• Proficient in Microsoft 365 — Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint — and quick to learn tools you haven't used before

• Discreet and professional in your handling of sensitive information; you understand what confidentiality means in a client-facing environment

• Curious about the work itself — you want to understand the engagements you're supporting, not just manage the calendar around them

Why This Role

What you get from working here

Directure is a small firm doing substantive work. That means the hierarchy is flat, the access is real, and your contributions are visible. You will not spend years waiting to be close to the interesting problems.This role is structured for someone who is serious about building a career in consulting — or who wants to develop a professional practice that sits across organisational and analytical work.

The remuneration reflects your qualifications.

How to Apply

Please send your CV and a brief cover letter under reference "CA" via e-mail to career@directure.com. Please note that we will invite, interview and select among candidates on an ongoing basis. We look forward to receiving your application, which will be treated in strictest confidence.

For more information about Directure please visit: www.directure.com

Join us in this role where you have ownership of trading strategies across Continental European and UK power markets, generating value through fundamental and quantitative insights while contributing to the transition to a renewable energy future.

As a Senior Trader, you'll operate within a defined risk mandate, identify and capture opportunities across the power curve, and help shape the future direction of our discretionary and systematic trading strategies. You'll work at the intersection of market intelligence, analytics, and technology, combining deep market understanding with innovative trading approaches to deliver strong commercial results.

Welcome to Market Trading

You'll become part of Continental & UK Trading, where we generate value through trading across European power, carbon, and gas markets. The team combines experienced traders, analysts, quants, and developers, creating an environment where market insights, data-driven decision making, and innovation come together.

In this role, you'll focus on Continental European and UK power curve products, leveraging your understanding of market fundamentals, cross-commodity relationships, and risk dynamics to identify and execute profitable trading opportunities.

As a team, we're ambitious, collaborative, and highly performance-oriented. We challenge each other's thinking, share knowledge openly, and continuously adapt to changing market conditions. This creates an exciting environment for experienced traders looking to make an impact while continuing to develop professionally.

You’ll play an important role in:

• delivering strong trading performance across Continental and UK power markets within an allocated risk mandate

• developing and executing trading strategies across forward and futures markets, with a particular focus on curve products

• identifying market opportunities through analysis of power fundamentals, weather, cross-border flows, fuel markets, carbon pricing, and broader macroeconomic developments

• helping shape and enhance systematic trading capabilities by collaborating closely with quantitative analysts and algorithmic developers

• actively managing risk and ensuring disciplined position management under changing market conditions

• translating market developments into actionable trading decisions and commercial outcomes.

To succeed in the role, you:

• have significant experience trading European power markets, especially Continental European and/or UK markets

• have a proven track record of delivering results within a delegated trading mandate and managing risk effectively

• possess a strong understanding of power market fundamentals and the key drivers influencing curve valuations

• can develop clear market views and translate them into profitable trading strategies

• combine strong analytical and numerical capabilities with sound commercial judgement

• are comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment where decisions must be made under uncertainty

• thrive in close collaboration with traders, analysts, quants, and developers

• communicate openly, challenge constructively, and contribute positively to a high-performing team culture.

Join a global leader in renewable energy

Ørsted is a global leader in offshore wind and is one of the largest renewable energy companies in the world. With us, you’ll play your part in creating a world that runs entirely on green energy. As a leading green energy company, we leverage the curiosity and passion of our people to innovate and develop new technologies or bring existing technologies to scale, collaborating with governments, suppliers, and our industry partners to make renewable energy solutions a reality. At Ørsted, we work together with openness and respect and seek fresh perspectives to solve any task at hand: big or small.

**About The Role

**As Commercial Manager you will help shape and execute the commercial agenda for some of 3Shape's strategically important businesses. Your mandate is to translate 3Shape strategies into scalable commercial programs that create value for customers, resellers, regional sales teams, and 3Shape.

The initial focus of the role is on our Laboratory business, with opportunities to expand the focus to other customer segments (Clinic & Enterprise) afterwards.

You will be a close commercial partner to regional teams and work across Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Customer Success, Finance, Operations, Sales Excellence, and Data & Analytics. The role combines commercial execution, program leadership, and operational excellence. You should be equally comfortable analyzing performance, developing a compelling commercial concept, aligning senior stakeholders, and rolling up your sleeves to operationalize it in the markets.

Your initial focus will be the Laboratory business and its indirect go-to-market model. You will connect partner strategy, end-customer opportunities, and frontline execution so that growth initiatives are grounded in data, converted into practical sales motions, and delivered with clear ownership and measurable impact.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Drive the reseller growth agenda by designing and implementing tangible, mutually beneficial commercial programs, including partner segmentation, growth plans, performance insights, incentives, enablement, and joint business planning.

• Own the commercial growth agenda for AI-powered Lab solutions, partnering across Regions, Product, Marketing, and Sales Excellence to accelerate adoption, maximize customer value realization, and develop AI into one of the largest and fastest-growing revenue streams within the business.

• Build a data-driven commercial agenda for Lab by translating customer, installed-base, pipeline, usage, renewal, and partner performance insights into prioritized growth opportunities and clear actions for regional and frontline teams.

• Develop and scale practical sales playbooks, value-selling materials, opportunity triggers, objection handling, and manager coaching tools that enable sales teams and resellers to identify, qualify, pursue, and convert growth opportunities.

• Conceptualize, test, and operationalize new commercial models, working across 3Shape to define the value proposition, partner economics, customer journey, governance, processes, and success metrics.

• Lead cross-functional commercial initiatives from problem definition through implementation, establishing clear workplans, decision points, ownership, adoption mechanisms, and measurable business outcomes.

• Act as a trusted business partner to regions and global functions, bringing market feedback into strategy, contributing to the rollout of our 2030 Lab Strategy, sharing best practices across markets, and ensuring that Lab priorities translate into consistent commercial execution.

**What we are looking for

**We recognize that strong candidates may have built relevant experience through different paths. For this role, we believe you will bring most of the following:

• Approximately 4+ years of experience in commercial strategy, management consulting, sales enablement, channel or partner management, commercial transformation, or another strategic commercial role.

jobs.occupation: Assistant Professor of Immunology at Department of Immunology and Microbiology (ISIM)
jobs.description:
We are looking for a highly motivated and dynamic assistant professor for the ‘Allergic Inflammation’ Group at the LEO Foundation Skin Immunology Research Centre for a two-year position starting from January 1, 2027.

  The Assistant Professor should have a strong background in Adaptive and Innate Immunity and its role in inflammatory diseases including allergy and autoimmunity. 

  Information on the department can be found at: https://sic.ku.dk/  

   

  Our research
 The Allergic Inflammation Group analyses the development of allergic diseases including atopic dermatitis, asthma, rhinitis and food allergy and tries to elucidate the genetic, cellular and molecular mechanisms of sensitisation. The group values teamwork and an interdisciplinary approach to discovery and has extensive local and international networks. We are a diverse team of researchers with interests in several areas but bound by an excitement to understand the basic principles of immune function.

   

  Your job 

  The role of Assistant Professor is very important for the team. We are looking for someone who has knowledge in our core areas of research and someone that can contribute to the team environment in several ways including in implementing independent research projects and in contributing to those of others in the group. The applicant should have led research projects in the past and demonstrate an ability to lead new diverse teams of researchers. A broad expertise in cellular and molecular immunology in the laboratory would be beneficial.  

  The assistant professor’s responsibilities will primarily consist of: 

   	
• research, including publication/academic dissemination duties  	
• research-based teaching  	
• sharing knowledge with students as part of the Masters education program 	
• participation in formal pedagogical training programme for assistant professors     

  Profile 
 Six overall criteria apply for assistant professor appointments at the University of Copenhagen. The six criteria (research, teaching, societal impact, organisational contribution, external funding, and leadership) are considered a framework for the overall assessment of candidates. Find information about each criterion here: https://employment.ku.dk/faculty/criteria-for-recognising-merit.

  Furthermore, we are looking for a highly motivated and enthusiastic scientist with the following skills and experience:

  Essential experience and skills:

   	
• You have a PhD in Immunology 	
• You are highly experienced in mouse models of skin and lung inflammation, flow cytometry, confocal microscopy and other immunohistochemistry techniques. 	
• You have an active interest in allergy, autoimmunity, microbial influences on disease 	
• You have pre- and postgraduate teaching experience within Immunology. 	
• Proficient communication skills and ability to work in teams 	
• Excellent English skills written and spoken 	
• A strong publication record and record of presenting your work at national and international meetings. 	
• Other basic lab techniques including ELISAs, cloning, RNA isolation and qPCR.   Desirable experience and skills:

   	
• Mouse models of infection including nematode infection, bacteria, viruses, and natural infectious models. 	
• Experience in teaching and mentorship 	
• Experience with grant applications    

  Place of employment

  The place of employment is at the LEO Foundation Skin Immunology Research Centre, Department of Immunology and Microbiology, University of Copenhagen. We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in dynamic and international research environment. Our research facilities include modern laboratories and access to state-of-the-art flow cytometry facilities, a core imaging facility, single cell and spatial RNA-Sequencing facilities and a large animal facility, which operates at several barrier levels.

   

  Terms of employment 

  The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week.

  The position is a fixed-term position limited to a period of 2 years. The start date is January 1, 2027 or as soon as possible.

  Salary, pension and other conditions of employment are set in accordance with the Agreement between the Ministry of Taxation and AC (Danish Confederation of Professional Associations) or other relevant organisation. Currently, the monthly salary starts at 39,993 DKK/approx. 5,350 EUR (August 2026 level). Depending on qualifications, a supplement may be negotiated. The employer will pay an additional 18.07 % to your pension fund.

   

  Foreign and Danish applicants may be eligible for tax reductions if they hold a PhD degree and have not lived in Denmark the last 10 years.

  The position is covered by the Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities 2020. 

   

  Questions
 For further information please contact Jonathan Coquet, jonathan.coquet@sund.ku.dk; www.sund.ku.dk 

  Foreign applicants may find this link useful: www.ism.ku.dk (International Staff Mobility).

   

  Application procedure
 Your application must be submitted in English by clicking ‘Apply now’ below. Furthermore, your application must include the following documents/attachments – all in PDF format:

   	
• Motivated letter of application (Max. one page) 	
• CV incl. education, work/research experience, language skills and other skills relevant for the position 	
• A certified/signed copy of a) PhD certificate and b) Master of Science certificate. If the PhD is not completed, a written statement from the supervisor will do 	
• List of publications 	
• Teaching portfolio (If applicable)    

  Deadline for applications: 22 October 2026, 23.59pm CET 

   

  We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not live up to the abovementioned requirements.

   

  The further process 
 After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the hiring committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment by an unbiased assessor. Once the assessment work has been completed each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself.

  You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/

   

  The applicant will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

   

  The University of Copenhagen wish to reflect the diversity of society and encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of personal background.

**What You Bring

You communicate complex technical topics clearly, build constructive relationships across functions, and balance attention to detail with an understanding of production needs and business priorities. You also enjoy helping others develop through coaching, knowledge sharing, and collaboration.

About MITS Industries

MITS Industries is establishing an R&D and design site in Copenhagen focused on advanced RF systems, signal intelligence, aerospace technologies, and mission-critical product development.

The site will build core engineering capabilities in RF and microwave hardware, antenna systems, RF testing and characterization, rugged mechanical integration, and the industrialization of complex radio-electronic systems.

The Copenhagen team will work closely with strategic partners and engineering teams across Europe, playing a leading role in the development, validation, and industrialization of advanced technologies for defense, aerospace, and other demanding applications.

One of the initial focus areas will be the development of an advanced aerospace signal intelligence product platform. The work will cover RF and system architecture, antenna system design, signal acquisition, embedded control, laboratory validation, mechanical integration, integration with the satellite platform, and preparation for production and field deployment.

The ambition is to build a strong technical design site capable of taking complex RF products, modules, and platforms from architecture and detailed design through prototyping, testing, validation, industrialization, and deployment.

About the role

MITS Industries is looking for a Senior Systems Engineer, RF Systems to join the core Copenhagen R&D team and help build the site’s systems engineering capability for advanced RF, aerospace, and signal-intelligence products. You will translate product, mission, and stakeholder needs into clear functional, performance, and parametric requirements, system architectures, subsystem allocation, interface definitions, integration strategies, and verification plans. The work covers requirements decomposition and traceability, system performance budgeting, interface management, technical risk analysis, design reviews, integration planning, and system level verification and validation. You will work closely with RF and microwave hardware engineers, antenna systems engineers, embedded and control engineers, signal-processing engineers, RF test and characterization engineers, mechanical design engineers, project managers, and partner engineering teams. You will ensure that requirements, design decisions, implementation, integration, testing, and validation remain connected throughout the development lifecycle. The role requires strong RF system understanding, structured systems-engineering expertise, technical ownership, and a hands-on integration mindset. Working with technical leadership, you will turn product and architectural intent into an executable, traceable, and verifiable engineering baseline and help carry the product through integration, qualification, and deployment.

Key responsibilities

• Translate product, mission, and stakeholder needs into clear functional, performance, parametric, interface, environmental, and verification requirements.

• Develop and maintain the functional and physical system architecture, allocate requirements to subsystems, and define key technical trade-offs.

• Establish and maintain system performance budgets and constraints covering RF performance, timing and synchronization, data flow, power, thermal performance, mass, and platform interfaces.

• Define and maintain system requirements, subsystem requirements, interface control documentation, acceptance criteria, and verification logic.

• Align RF subsystem requirements, including frequency coverage, sensitivity, selectivity, dynamic range, noise figure, linearity, phase noise, spurious responses, channel isolation, and interference resilience.

• Define antenna-system requirements covering frequency coverage, antenna gain, polarization, radiation-pattern characteristics, isolation between antenna channels, placement, and platform integration.

• Define embedded control, data acquisition, timing, synchronization, diagnostics, logging, networking, and system-monitoring requirements.

• Coordinate mechanical and platform requirements covering dimensions, mass, thermal management, connectors, cabling, grounding, shielding, mounting, environmental constraints, and serviceability.

• Work with RF test and characterization engineers to define measurable acceptance criteria, calibration needs, verification methods, test coverage, and required evidence.

• Prepare and maintain system requirements specifications, interface-control documents, system budgets, integration plans, verification plans, compliance matrices, and technical decision records.

• Lead system integration planning and support prototype bring-up, laboratory validation, qualification, and field-test preparation.

• Identify system-level risks, interface conflicts, missing requirements, invalid assumptions, and integration blockers, and drive their resolution.

• Facilitate cross-functional technical alignment between engineering disciplines, technical leadership, manufacturing partners, and partner engineering teams.

• Support requirements reviews, system design reviews, integration reviews, test readiness reviews, and milestone decisions.

• Maintain traceability between stakeholder needs, requirements, design decisions, implementation, verification results, and acceptance evidence.

• Help establish systems-engineering methods, documentation practices, requirements-management workflows, and technical-review processes for future MITS Industries development programs.

Required qualifications and experience

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in electrical or electronic engineering, telecommunications, systems engineering, aerospace engineering, applied physics, or a related field.

• 6+ years of professional experience in systems engineering for complex RF, electronic, aerospace, or other mission-critical systems.

• Strong understanding of RF systems, including receiver architectures, RF signal paths, antenna interfaces, signal acquisition, data conversion, embedded control, timing and synchronization, calibration, and system validation.

• Proven experience translating product, mission, and stakeholder needs into functional, performance, parametric, interface, environmental, and verification requirements.

• Experience developing functional and physical system architectures, decomposing systems into subsystems, allocating requirements, and defining interfaces and technical trade-offs.

• Experience establishing and maintaining system performance budgets and constraints covering RF performance, timing and synchronization, data flow, power, thermal performance, mass, and platform interfaces.

• Strong understanding of requirements decomposition, traceability, acceptance criteria, and verification methods, including analysis, inspection, demonstration, and testing.

• Experience preparing and maintaining system requirements specifications, interface-control documents, integration plans, verification plans, compliance matrices, and technical decision records.

• Practical experience with requirements-management and traceability tools such as IBM Engineering DOORS, Jama Connect, Polarion, or equivalent.

• Experience working with cross-functional engineering teams covering RF and microwave hardware, antennas, embedded systems, signal processing, mechanical design, test, manufacturing, and system integration.

• Ability to evaluate technical trade-offs across RF performance, embedded implementation, mechanical and thermal constraints, testability, manufacturability, reliability, and operational use.

• Hands-on experience with prototype integration, laboratory validation, system-level debugging, and troubleshooting of complex multidisciplinary systems.

• Experience identifying and managing system-level risks, interface conflicts, assumptions, technical dependencies, and integration blockers. Strong technical communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to align senior engineers and drive decisions across engineering disciplines.

Nice to have

• Experience with signal-intelligence, direction-finding, spectrum-monitoring, or radio-surveillance systems.

• Experience with SDR-based systems and high-throughput RF data acquisition.

• Experience with broadband, multiband, coherent, or multichannel receiver systems.

• Experience with Model-Based Systems Engineering, SysML, and tools such as Cameo Systems Modeler, Enterprise Architect, or equivalent.

• Experience establishing and maintaining controlled system baselines, including requirements, interfaces, verification status, configuration, and engineering changes.

• Experience with engineering analysis, data processing, or system modelling using MATLAB, Python, or equivalent.

• Experience with field integration, testing, calibration, and deployment of complex RF or aerospace systems.

• Experience working on aerospace, mission-critical, ruggedized, or internationally distributed engineering programs.

Success in the first 6 months

• Establish the initial system requirements baseline, subsystem allocation, interface definitions, and performance budgets for the assigned product scope.

• Create a clear technical decomposition across RF and microwave hardware, antenna systems, embedded control, signal processing, mechanical design, test, and system integration.

• Define the integration, verification, and validation approach for the initial prototype or subsystem, including acceptance criteria, traceability, and required evidence.

• Identify unclear interfaces, missing requirements, technical assumptions, and system-level risks early, and drive practical resolution actions. Support prototype integration, bring-up, and laboratory validation with structured system-level analysis, troubleshooting, and verification evidence.

• Establish repeatable systems-engineering practices, documentation templates, requirements-management workflows, and technical-review processes for future development programs.

Are you motivated by how companies decide which products, technologies, and business opportunities to invest in? Do you enjoy combining market insight, customer needs, financial potential, and strategic analysis to support difficult decisions? Are you looking for an internship where you can contribute to strategic portfolio decisions in Kamstrup’s international Heat/Cooling business?

Here is what your role entails

As our intern, you will work closely with Strategic Portfolio Management on questions that influence the direction of the Heat/Cooling business. You will contribute to portfolio strategy, evaluate business opportunities, analyse the balance of the portfolio, and help prepare recommendations for prioritisation and investment decisions.

More specifically, you will be:

• Contributing to the annual portfolio strategy process for the Heat/Cooling business

• Mapping customer needs, market trends, competitor movements, and technology developments

• Analysing business opportunities and assessing their strategic fit and value potential

• Developing business cases, portfolio dashboards, and decision material for management reviews

• Supporting prioritisation discussions across development initiatives

You will take ownership of analytical assignments and contribute directly to ongoing portfolio decisions. At the same time, you will gain insight into how strategic choices are made across Product Management, Sales, Finance, and Research and Development.

Meet your future team

You will become part of our Product Management Team in the Heat/Cooling department, where you will work closely together with Strategic Portfolio Management. In Strategic Portfolio Management, we challenge ideas, prioritize business opportunities, and then support them as projects on their way to our customers. Using sales numbers, market input, customer interviews, and strategic priorities, we give guidance to the organization on what to build next. We do so by seeking out data and diverse perspectives to challenge each other’s assumptions. Otherwise, we enjoy a relaxed atmosphere, and we are not shy about celebrating successes and learnings along the way.

Less about us, more about you

We are looking for an ambitious bachelor’s or master’s student who are curious about how companies make strategic investment decisions and motivated by analysing complex questions and turning your insights into clear recommendations.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Are currently studying, or have an interest in, International Business, Business Development, Economics, Innovation Management, or Technology Management

• Have experience with Excel and PowerPoint and are comfortable working with both quantitative and qualitative information

• Are interested in how AI can be applied in your daily work

• Can structure ambiguous problems and identify the most important questions

• Communicate complex insights in a simple and convincing way and thrive when collaborating with stakeholders

As we are an international organisation it is important that you are fluent in English and Danish.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, this is an internship position, and we value curiosity and a willingness to learn just as much as experience. If the role interests you and you are motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply.

We offer more than just an internship

At Kamstrup, your contribution as an intern is highly valued, and we cherish the good colleagueship. Therefore, you will experience an internship with a strong focus on your individual development through challenging tasks, career sparring, voluntary courses, as well as social events and a large network. We are proud, that our internship program has resulted in Studenterhus Aarhus granting us with the Mentor Award, the Internationalization Award, the Jury’s Special Award and the award for East Jutland’s Best Internship.

Besides the best program, we also offer:

• A gratuity which may be provided in recognition of your efforts if your place of study allows it as well as paid public transportation to and from work

• Multiple internship events and weekly internship lunches

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in-house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association, that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

Do you want to be a part of Kamstrup?

The applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, but you can expect a response within six weeks. Any details about the internship will be individually agreed upon. However, the internship is expected to run from the beginning of February 2027 until the end of June 2027.

Kamstrup is located in Stilling south of Aarhus, and bus number 200 takes you right to the door.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Strategic Portfolio Manager Anders Rønnau on phone: +45 89 93 10 00.

🇩🇰 ER DU VORES NYE MEDARBEJDER?

Tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt!

RenTid søger en erfaren rengøringsassistent til en fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen med mulighed for merarbejde.

Læs og forstå hele opslaget, før du ansøger. Vi forventer, at du har læst og forstået opslaget, inden du søger stillingen. Ansøgninger fra personer, der ikke opfylder de grundlæggende krav i opslaget, vil ikke komme i betragtning.

RenTid er en virksomhed i vækst, og vi søger en erfaren rengøringsassistent, som er dygtig til sit håndværk og har lyst til at udvikle sig sammen med os. Hos RenTid spiller øje for et perfekt resultat og sans for detaljen en stor rolle.

Du bliver ansat som rengøringsassistent og skal først og fremmest levere rengøring af høj kvalitet hos vores kunder i Aarhus og omegn.

Vi ser ikke kun på dit CV – vi ser på din arbejdsmoral, ansvarlighed, kvalitet og lyst til at udvikle dig.

🇩🇰 🚀 MULIGHED FOR UDVIKLING

Når RenTid vokser, opstår der nye muligheder. Den rette medarbejder kan med tiden få ansvar for eksempelvis:

• 
Kvalitetskontrol

• 
Oplæring af nye medarbejdere

• 
Kundekontakt

• 
Koordinering og planlægning

• 
Teamlederfunktioner

• 
Større driftsansvar

Hvor langt du kan komme, afhænger i høj grad af dig.

🇩🇰 🧹 VI FORVENTER, AT DU:

• 
Har solid erfaring med rengøring i private hjem.

• 
Ikke er bange for at arbejde alene.

• 
Gerne har erfaring med erhvervsrengøring.

• 
Arbejder selvstændigt og grundigt, men også kan fungere i mindre teams.

• 
Har øje for detaljer og kvalitet.

• 
Er mødestabil, fleksibel og ansvarsbevidst.

• 
Har en positiv indstilling og tager imod feedback.

• 
Har kørekort B og ikke er bange for at køre bil er et "Must". Du skal ikke søge stillingen, hvis du ikke har kørekort og lyst til at køre bil.

• 
Selv kan komme til og fra arbejdspladsen i Aarhus.

• 
Er indstillet på, at der kan forekomme weekendarbejde. Kan du ikke arbejde i weekenderne, så er RenTid ikke stedet for dig.

🇬🇧 SPROG – VIGTIGT

Du skal kunne tale, forstå, læse og skrive flydende engelsk.

Du skal ikke søge stillingen, hvis du ikke taler og forstår engelsk.

Dansk er en klar fordel, men ikke et krav.

⏱️ PRØVEPERIODE

De første 3 måneder er en prøveperiode efter gældende danske regler.

Her vurderer vi blandt andet din arbejdsindsats, kvalitet, samarbejde, ansvarlighed og udvikling.

💰 LØN OG MULIGHEDER

Du får en god og ordentlig løn fra starten.

Din startløn vil være 145,00 kr. pr. time, plus 12,5 % feriepenge og ATP efter gældende regler.

Større ansvar, højere løn og andre goder følger med, når du viser, at du kan løfte mere.

Efter de 3 måneders prøvetid har du mulighed for at genforhandle din løn ud fra de kvalifikationer og den udvikling, du har vist os i løbet af prøveperioden.

Vi leder efter en person, der ikke bare søger et job – men gerne vil være en del af RenTids udvikling.

📍 ARBEJDSOMRÅDE

Aarhus og omegn.

RenTid stiller bil til rådighed for dig eller teamet i arbejdstiden.

📩 LYDER DET SOM DIG?

Send os en motiveret ansøgning og CV med billede.

Fortæl kort om:

• 
Dig selv

• 
Din erfaring med rengøring

• 
Din erfaring med private hjem

• 
Eventuel erfaring med erhvervsrengøring

• 
Hvad du gerne vil udvikle dig inden for

Ansøgningen skal være på engelsk.

Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler.

🇬🇧 ARE YOU OUR NEW EMPLOYEE?

Start date: As soon as possible!

RenTid is looking for an experienced cleaning assistant for a full-time position of 37 hours per week, with the possibility of additional hours.

Please read and understand the entire job advertisement before applying. We expect you to have read and understood the advertisement before applying for the position. Applications from candidates who do not meet the basic requirements will not be considered.

RenTid is a growing company, and we are looking for an experienced cleaning assistant who is skilled at their workand motivated to develop and grow with us. At RenTid, attention to detail and delivering a perfect result are extremely important.

You will be employed as a cleaning assistant, and your primary responsibility will be to provide high-quality cleaningfor our customers in Aarhus and the surrounding area.

We do not only look at your CV – we look at your work ethic, responsibility, quality of work and willingness to develop.

🚀 OPPORTUNITIES FOR DEVELOPMENT

As RenTid grows, new opportunities will arise. The right employee may, over time, take on responsibility for areas such as:

• 
Quality control

• 
Training new employees

• 
Customer contact

• 
Coordination and planning

• 
Team leader responsibilities

• 
Greater operational responsibility

How far you can go depends largely on you.

🧹 WE EXPECT YOU TO:

• 
Have solid experience in residential cleaning.

• 
Not be afraid of working independently.

• 
Preferably have experience with commercial cleaning.

• 
Be able to work independently and thoroughly, while also being comfortable working in small teams.

• 
Have a strong eye for detail and quality.

• 
Be reliable, flexible and responsible.

• 
Have a positive attitude and be open to feedback.

• 
Have a valid Category B driving licence and be comfortable driving a car – this is a MUST. Please do not apply if you do not have a driving licence or are not willing to drive.

• 
Be able to get to and from the workplace in Aarhus independently.

• 
Be prepared for occasional weekend work. If you are unable to work weekends, RenTid is not the right place for you.

🇬🇧 LANGUAGE – IMPORTANT

You must be able to speak, understand, read and write fluent English.

Please do not apply if you do not speak and understand English.

Danish is a clear advantage, but not a requirement.

⏱️ PROBATIONARY PERIOD

The first 3 months will be a probationary period in accordance with applicable Danish rules.

During this period, we will evaluate your work performance, quality, cooperation, responsibility and development.

💰 SALARY AND OPPORTUNITIES

You will receive a fair and competitive salary from the beginning.

Your starting salary will be DKK 145.00 per hour, plus 12.5% holiday pay and ATP in accordance with applicable Danish rules.

Greater responsibility, higher pay and other benefits will follow as you demonstrate that you are capable of taking on more responsibility.

After the 3-month probationary period, you will have the opportunity to renegotiate your salary based on the qualifications and development you have demonstrated during the probationary period.

We are looking for someone who is not just looking for a job – but someone who wants to become part of RenTid’s continued development.

📍 WORK AREA

Aarhus and surrounding areas.

RenTid provides a company car for you or the team during working hours.

📩 DOES THIS SOUND LIKE YOU?

Send us a motivated application and CV with a photo.

Please briefly tell us about:

• 
Yourself

• 
Your experience in cleaning

• 
Your experience with residential cleaning

• 
Any experience with commercial cleaning

• 
What areas you would like to develop your skills in

Your application must be written in English.

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis.
